newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks marginally down in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks marginally down in London.

text.p: Japanese shares were virtually unchanged in quiet London trading on Wednesday, with selling in some high-tech issues weighing on the market overall, traders said.
London's Nikkei ISE 50 index fell marginally by 0.01 points to 1,462.49 by 1430 GMT, after profit-taking sent Tokyo's Nikkei 225 index down 32.74 points lower to 21,397.19 earlier today.
Yet traders said the market's underlying tone remained confident, with the Japanese elections due to be held at the weekend and public funds seen taking advantage of the dip in the market to buy.
"The market has good support at the moment and the Nikkei 225 index could be up 100 points tomorrow," said one trader.
Traders said the only interest in London trading was provided by bargain-hunting in weaker shares and selling pressure on some high-tech stocks.
By 1405 GMT JAL shares traded at 714-1/2 yen in London, up 7-1/2 yen on their overnight Tokyo close, while Sony was at 7,100 yen, 20 yen down on its overnight close in Tokyo.
